query: DDR5 RAM prices November 2026 shortage 32GB kit price increase
answer: On November 2, 2026, the lowest tracked 32GB DDR5 desktop kit at Amazon was $479.99, with a median of $554.99 across 22 listings, up from $429 earlier in the year. This represents a price increase of 473% from the all-time low of $72 for a 32GB DDR5-6000 kit. The price surge is attributed to a global shortage linked to AI, with prices rising by +80% to +130% since September 2025.

## Don’t expect DDR5 price decreases anytime soon [...] It’s been a while since we last looked at DDR5 memory prices. In November 2025, memory prices started to shoot up, and since then, pricing has only got worse. Now, a standard 32GB kit of DDR5-6000 memory (2x16GB) now costs over £400. That’s over 5x higher than this time last year. AI datacenter demand has decimated the consumer memory market. While manufacturers earn billions, consumers are paying insane prices for memory and the products that use it.
